glosses: audience, those who see, hear, read some work or performance (crowd, viewership, readership etc.)
members of the public who frequent some place, institution, establishment

examples.text: Können Sie gut vor Publikum sprechen?
examples.en: Are you good at public speaking?

examples.text: Sie spricht nicht gern vor Publikum.
examples.en: She doesn't like to speak in public.

examples.text: Ich glaube, das Publikum fand es lustig.
examples.en: I think the audience thought it was funny.
